name: SVR Poker Android
nextApkDrop: Only after the Android web game passes a stable playtest batch.
notes: Do not force testers to update the APK every phase.
Use the stable Android web route for ongoing game logic and UX updates.
Phase 332 permanently locks the existing table asset, felt/leather/trim materials, smaller denomination chips, Quest chip gravity, pass-line betting, and table-surface alignment.
Quest/Oculus physics remains on the separate WebXR route; Android keeps its stable touch-first route.
Director preview remains separate and must contain no Android controls or visible runtime overlays.
Build a new native APK only when native app code, package, permissions, signing, icon, WebView shell, or release channel changes.
